description: Notary: Get a signed receipt for a hash or text; a repeat returns the first. The stamped hash is data.result.hash, its proof data.result.log.proof; data.receipt is the billing receipt only. Free, no key needed, within a daily limit; at most 100 new receipts a day per network. Signed as your identity when this connection has one, within its daily limit.

max_cost.description: optional: your ceiling in credit; a higher price is refused, nothing spent. Default: the quote

request_id.description: optional retry key: a retry from your network returns the first answer, never charged twice (another network: 409). Left out, call.request_id returns one; yours: random, new per call

text.description: or up to 16 KiB of text, hashed and never stored

name: notary_stamp
title: Notary stamp
